narrative.details:
This greenish liquid... it reminds me a bit of the sludge I saw when traveling through Felwood. And I have seen some Winterfall Runners passing into Timbermaw... Perhaps these things have something to do with the flask you found, adventurer.

There is a large group of furbolg just past Timbermaw Hold, in Felwood. Called the Deadwood tribe, they have been corrupted and driven mad by the fel. Why don't you look around there and see if you can find any evidence of dealings between the Winterfall and the Deadwood?
narrative.objectives: Search the Deadwood furbolg camp in northern Felwood for a clue.
narrative.offerRewardText: Inside the cauldron bubbles a rotting, repulsive-smelling substance...

chain.subtitle: 8 quests from level 56 to 59, 39,400 XP in all.

quests.name: Winterfall Firewater
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Empty Firewater Flask to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

quests.name: Falling to Corruption
quests.objectiveText: Search the Deadwood furbolg camp in northern Felwood for a clue.

quests.name: Mystery Goo
quests.objectiveText: Report back to Donova Snowden with your findings.

quests.name: Toxic Horrors
quests.objectiveText: Collect 3 Toxic Horror Droplets for Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

quests.name: Winterfall Runners
quests.objectiveText: Find the Winterfall Runners and stop them from delivering their shipment to Winterfall Village.

quests.name: High Chief Winterfall
quests.objectiveText: Donova Snowden in Winterspring wants you to defeat High Chief Winterfall.

quests.name: The Final Piece
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Crudely-written Log to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

quests.name: Words of the High Chief
quests.objectiveText: Take the Crudely-written Log to Kelek Skykeeper in southern Felwood.
